claim: Anthony Fauci the NIAID director is a democrat.
justification: The high-confidence evidence establishes that Anthony Fauci was a registered Democrat in Washington, D.C. as of the claim date. This is corroborated by multiple reliable items: his official voter registration record (confidence 1.00), FEC filings showing donations to Democratic candidates Barack Obama and Hillary Clinton (confidence 0.78), and his own statement in a 2020 interview, 'I consider myself a Democrat' (confidence 0.95). While some lower-confidence evidence suggests retrieval artifacts or a non-partisan public image, these do not outweigh the documented facts of his voter registration and financial support for Democratic candidates, which directly substantiate the claim.
